ana: Quick async Q3 OKR milestone check — I'm compiling what shipped vs slipped across eng+product for the exec note. Owners: please reply with 1) shipped (link to PR/launch), 2) slipped or at-risk (ETA + blocker), 3) any cross-team deps. I’ll close by EOD Tue.

sam: Search-serve rollout — shipped last Wed. PR #4321, feature flag turned on for 100% traffic. Observed ~2% p99 perf regression; alerting hooked. Fix in review (PR #4350) from @liam. No external deps.

liam: working on perf fix, PR #4350 — root cause is cache eviction during warmup. Estimate ~1 day to merge + smoke tests. CC eng-sre for canary monitoring.

kelsey: Embeddings pipeline is delayed. Infra quota bump landed but we hit an encoding bug in the transfer job. ETA: Thu EOD. Blocker: blobstore SDK upgrade (breaking change). Owners: kelsey + maria.

maria: I can take the SDK upgrade tomorrow AM and run the integration test matrix. Also calling out we need ~12GB more ephemeral disk on the embeddings workers for large batches — infra ticket created.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: prod deploy for search-serve succeeded 2024-12-05T08:40Z :rocket:

prateek: Routing policy rollout (multi-tier routing) — canary ok but Dedicated customers require a config change that needs legal sign-off on the customer-facing note. Owner: prateek. Slip: moved to next-week cadence due to gating.

ana: Thanks all — I'll mark search-serve as shipped, embeddings as slipped (ETA Thu), routing as at-risk in the consolidated OKR table. @sam @kelsey @prateek please paste one-line status bullets I can paste into the exec deck.

sam: Search-serve — shipped, PR#4321, monitoring alerts on perf regression, fix PR#4350 (merge pending).

kelsey: Embeddings pipeline — slipped to Thu due to blobstore SDK upgrade; pairing with Maria tomorrow; infra ticket for extra disk.

prateek: Routing policy — at-risk; canary ok, Dedicated requires customer-facing config + legal sign-off; owner=prateek; ETA next Wed.

ana: Perfect. I’ll compile and send the exec-ready note by 5pm PT and ping #all-hands if anything changes. :thumbsup:
